title: Board Typst Split Emoji Fontbook
description: Split Typst font pools: typst:/math uses typst_assets only; emoji: uses typst_assets + NotoColorEmoji-subset so COLR font does not break math icon compilation.
summary: Noto Color Emoji was merged into the single Typst FontBook used for all icon Typst compiles, which broke `typst:`/math (empty compile → no icon). Split into two static pools: `typst_assets` only for `board_typst_markup_to_svg`, and `typst_assets` + Noto subset + `board_typst_markup_to_svg_for_icon_emoji` for the `emoji:` branch only.
